game.name: Arcana Heart 3 (Europe)
game.desc: Arcana Heart 3 on Xbox 360 is a 2D fighting game adapted from the arcade. The game offers 23 fighters, each one cuter than the other. There is something for everyone, from cat girls to loligoths, maids and schoolgirls. The title allows local matches for 2 players and also offers an online mode where 2 warriors can fight each other under the eye of 4 spectators.
